question: Should ClickClack adopt persisted message reactions as a supported permanent core chat interaction once the thread-pane gap is fixed?
rationale: This PR introduces a new user-facing interaction rather than repairing an established contract, and the available review context contains no maintainer decision accepting that product surface.

options.title: Sponsor core reactions
options.body: Accept message reactions as core functionality, require the thread-pane completion, and review the completed feature for merge.

options.title: Defer the interaction
options.body: Keep the implementation out of the current roadmap until a maintainer defines the intended scope and UX for reactions.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core reactions
recommendation.body: Accept message reactions as core functionality, require the thread-pane completion, and review the completed feature for merge.

likelyOwner.reason: No concrete current-main history or maintainer assignment was available to identify a specific product owner safely.
